symptoms: Early instar larvae skeletonize young leaves
Later instars bore into developing pods, keeping anterior body inside the pod and posterior outside
Distinct circular bore-holes on pods with completely hollowed-out empty grains
lookalikes: Armyworm (Spodoptera exigua) - which primarily feeds on leaves in gregarious clusters
favourable_conditions: Warm days (22-28°C) with low relative humidity during pod setting
season_or_growth_stage: Flowering and pod filling stage (50 to 90 DAS)
monitoring_and_confirmation: Install Helilure pheromone traps @ 5 traps/acre; ETL: 1 larva per meter row or 5-8 moths/trap/night
prevention: Plant 1 row of Marigold or Coriander for every 10 rows of chickpea as trap crop
Install bird perches ('T'-shaped wooden perches @ 20/acre) for predatory birds like drongos
cultural_management: Intercropping with mustard, linseed, or barley reduces pod borer incidence
mechanical_management: Shake plants vigorously over plastic sheets in early morning to dislodge caterpillars
biological_management: Spray Helicoverpa armigera Nuclear Polyhedrosis Virus (HaNPV) @ 100-150 LE/acre with 0.1% jaggery in evening hours

organic_options.preparation_or_formulation: Freshly extracted 5% aqueous suspension with soap surfactant
organic_options.timing: At 50% flowering to prevent egg laying and early larval development
limitations: Must be applied early before larvae enter inside pods; ineffective against mature 4th-5th instar larvae.

chemical_options.dilution: 5 to 6 ml per 15-liter spray pump (50 ml/acre in 150-200 L water)
chemical_options.timing: At appearance of small larvae on pods upon exceeding ETL (1 larva/meter row)
mixing_warnings: Do not mix with chemical fertilizers or alkaline sprays.
chemical_options.safety_advisory: Verified against CIBRC label and ICAR/SAU package of practices. Follow standard PPE and PHI guidelines.

chemical_options.dilution: 8 to 10 g per 15-liter spray pump (80-100 g/acre in 200 L water)
mixing_warnings: Spray strictly in late afternoon when bees are not foraging.
chemical_options.safety_advisory: Verified against CIBRC label and ICAR/SAU package of practices. Follow standard PPE and PHI guidelines.

resistance_management: Rotate chemistries between Diamides and Avermectins; never repeat same chemistry in subsequent generations.
expert_referral_conditions: Contact local KVK agronomist or Kisan Call Centre (1800-180-1551) if infestation exceeds threshold.
